title: Spec Step 1 code example uses invalid Rust syntax: char vs &str
description: The specification's Step 1 code example uses replace('\r', '\n') where the second argument is a char literal. Rust's str::replace requires &str for the replacement argument, causing a compile error. The implementation was fixed to use replace('\r', "\n"). The spec is immutable so the discrepancy remains.
proposed_resolution: Add a rubric criterion or linting check that validates Rust code examples in spec Step sections against the Rust compiler before a spec is accepted, to catch type-level errors in examples before implementation.

title: Missing moeb tool: Bash (cargo test / cargo build)
description: Used Bash to run cargo test -p moeb and cargo build --release for the all-tests-pass and binary-builds rubric criteria. No moeb equivalent exists for shell command or build/test execution. This forces moeb-tool-origin to fail on every run that checks build and test criteria.
proposed_resolution: Run moeb spec to introduce a run_command or cargo tool covering cargo build and cargo test execution, so rubric verification can be performed without external Bash calls.
